name: IGF-1 LR3
description: Man-made analogue of insulin-like growth factor 1 with an added chain and one amino acid changed

note.text: Mecasermin (Increlex), the approved IGF-1 drug, has the body’s natural sequence. IGF-1 LR3 has no published human study.

bullets: **Binds about 1,000 times less** to the IGF binding proteins in blood
**In rats,** cleared faster than IGF-1 yet about six times more potent for growth
Used mainly in **cell culture and animal research**
**In people,** the mechanism is not established
Rat, pig, sheep and cell studies

regulatory.text: Not approved; Increlex is a different drug

references: Growth Regul, Long R3 IGF-I potency and clearance in rats, Mar 1993
Front Endocrinol, review of growth-hormone-related peptides, Jun 2026
